summary: Yarr is a web-based feed aggregator designed to collect and display content from various web feeds. It functions as a standalone desktop application or as a self-hosted server accessible via a browser.
goodFor: Users who want a lightweight, self-hosted feed reader with minimal resource consumption that can be accessed from multiple devices.
watchOut: The software occupies a crowded space alongside mature alternatives, meaning it may lack advanced filtering or third-party syncing integrations found in larger projects.
deployNotes: Being built with Go, it typically compiles into a single binary that requires persistent storage for your feed database and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
